title: Add ggsql package
description: Register the [ggsql](https://github.com/posit-dev/ggsql-r) R package so that pre-built binaries are available from the posit-dev R-universe. This will allow downstream packages (e.g., querychat) to install ggsql without needing a Rust toolchain or tree-sitter-cli.

title: Add gradethis extension packages
description:
This PR adds the [tblcheck](https://pkgs.rstudio.com/tblcheck/index.html) and [ggcheck](https://rstudio.github.io/ggcheck/) packages in order to build web assembly binary versions of these packages so they are available for use with webR. These packages extend the functionality of [gradethis](https://rstudio.github.io/gradethis/articles/gradethis.html), which can be used for grading interactive exercises in Quarto Live: https://r-wasm.github.io/quarto-live/exercises/gradethis.html.

These packages are currently not avaialble on the [webR public package repo](https://repo.r-wasm.org/).
